description: Current figures for the topics shown on the public GAtrends radar (Steam players online, news articles in 3 hours, Reddit posts, Wikipedia views) and whether each is above its usual level. Read-only, no account needed. To watch your own keywords use a personal GAtrends connector (Pro and Business).
